en: Confirm the species, plant part and traceable starting lot.
Drying or size reduction may prepare the material for extraction.
A selected medium transfers soluble constituents from the material.
Filtration or centrifugation can remove suspended solids.
Remove solvent; use selective separation only where needed.
Some routes produce powders; others remain liquid.
Check identity, composition and agreed acceptance criteria.
Steps vary by product. This schematic is not a real facility.
zh: 确认物种、植物部位与可追溯的起始批次。
干燥或粒度调整可为提取准备原料。
所选介质使可溶成分从原料转移出来。
过滤或离心可去除悬浮固体。
去除溶剂；按需要进行选择性分离。
部分路线制成粉末，其他路线保留液体形态。
检查身份、组成与约定的验收指标。
步骤随产品变化。本示意不是真实厂房。
